use_case_summary: SMB customer support automation startup. Primary goal: ingest incoming support tickets, produce concise structured summaries and suggested actions. Want tool-calling for operations (create ticket, tag priority, enqueue SLA alert). Must produce JSON output for downstream routing. Latency target: median summary <400ms, p95 <1s for single-ticket summaries. Throughput: bursty — ~15-30 reqs/sec during peak. Cost-sensitive: prefer cheaper open models for background summarization, burst to higher-quality model for live agent assist. Looking for hosted API (self-serve) to start, want quick proof-of-concept then potentially upgrade to Dedicated when scale grows.

support for streaming responses for agent UI
ability to route to cheaper model variant during batch summarization
